findings.title: Patience as an epistemic procedure
findings.claim: The focus reading shifts from "Patience means tolerating hardship and obeying commands." to "Here patience means remaining in the learning relation while suspending interrogative judgment until an event's hidden account is initiated.".
findings.mechanism: The adjacent challenge locates failure in incomplete access to an event's interior; the following rule operationalizes patience as continuing to follow while withholding questions until the guide originates an account. Obedience thus becomes a temporal-epistemic procedure, not silent approval.
findings.reader_payoff: Patience becomes a procedure for staying inside a learning relation while inquiry is temporally gated.
findings.containment: The trace is retained as attributed contextual evidence; its live alternative is that the adjacent clauses state separate etiquette rules rather than defining patience.

findings.title: The affair command as a stress test
findings.claim: The focus reading shifts from "I will not violate any instruction you give." to "I will not let an affair that appears monstrous become sufficient grounds to exit your instruction before the action's source and outcome are disclosed.".
findings.mechanism: The pledged object أمر is immediately redescribed through its own branch range: an apparently monstrous affair, the learner's burdened affair, and finally action denied as arising from the guide's own affair or initiative. Obedience is tested precisely where a directive and an alarming state no longer look morally compatible.
findings.reader_payoff: The command's affair becomes a class of events whose shocking appearance cannot by itself authorize departure from instruction.
findings.containment: The trace is retained as attributed contextual evidence; it does not claim that every affair is monstrous or that obedience cancels moral evaluation.

findings.title: A pledge exposed to counterexample
findings.claim: The focus reading shifts from "You will discover that my patience is a stable trait." to "You will test a contingent forecast in escalating cases; the objections falsify its unqualified form, and only afterward does outcome knowledge explain why restraint was demanded.".
findings.mechanism: Two shocking interventions provoke immediate objections, each followed by a refrain about capacity for patience. The learner then makes one more question terminate companionship; separation and retrospective outcome expose the focus claim as a staged, falsifiable self-prediction rather than a successful vow.
findings.reader_payoff: The pledge becomes a forecast exposed to counterexamples, with later outcomes supplying the explanation for the demanded restraint.
findings.containment: The trace is retained as attributed contextual evidence; it does not claim that the learner's objections are irrational or that later explanations erase the real shocks.

findings.title: Distributed will and command
findings.claim: The focus reading shifts from "God willing is a pious qualification attached to a promise." to "God willing anticipates the episode's central agency distinction: a person can perform and intend at the visible level while realization and originating command remain beyond that person's private will.".
findings.mechanism: The focus gives the learner's future state to divine willing. Later the learner attributes a wage-option to the guide's willing; the explanations distribute I intended, we intended, and your Lord intended, then deny that the acts arose from the guide's own affair. The contingency becomes an agency grammar: visible first-person action need not be self-originating.
findings.reader_payoff: The pious conditional becomes a grammar of layered agency rather than a detachable courtesy.
findings.containment: The trace is retained as attributed contextual evidence; its live alternative is rhetorical variation among independently motivated speakers rather than a hierarchy of agency.

epistemic.reason: The external surface is supplied exactly, while the worship-and-aid contact is a bounded Phase-2 inference.

branch_activations.carrier: The external 1:5 worship occurrence at 1:5:2 carries the worship-side contact.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus non-disobedience occurrence at 18:69:8:1 supplies the obedience contact.
branch_activations.activation: Worship in the external overlay meets the focus's explicit refusal to disobey the guide's command.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The pledge can be heard as a devotional obedience rather than only interpersonal compliance.
branch_activations.boundary: The external branch descriptor is unresolved; this does not claim that the focus word itself means worship.

branch_activations.carrier: The external 1:5 assistance occurrence at 1:5:4 carries the aid-side contact.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus patience occurrence at 18:69:6:1 supplies the endurance contact.
branch_activations.activation: Requested assistance meets the focus's promised endurance, adding a supported-dependence frame to patience.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Patience is perceptible as endurance sustained within requested assistance, not self-sufficiency alone.
branch_activations.boundary: The external branch descriptor is unresolved; this does not claim that the focus word itself means assistance.
